newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar up on consumer buys, limited offerings.
newsitem.headline: India sugar up on consumer buys, limited offerings.

text.p: Increased consumer buying ahead of festivals drove sugar prices up on Tuesday as limited offerings by millers kept supplies at a low ebb, dealers said.
"Price rise however remained modest as state governments have increased the quantum of sugar supplied through public distribution systems for festivals," one broker said.
"Higher supplies of sugar in the public distribution system have curtailed festival buying in the open market," he added.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by 3 rupees at 1,480/1,508 rupees per quintal while M-30 looked up by the same margin at 1,504/1,535 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery looked up amid limited offerings by millers but traders reported slow outstation demand at the mill level.
In the mill delivery, sugar S-30 rose by 10 rupees at 1,420/1,430 rupees per quintal while M-30 rose by 5 rupees at 1,440/1,455 rupees per quintal.
